int_name: E ROOSEVELT BLVD & TOWER BOULEVARD DWY

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, unmarked commercial entrance that lacks basic crossing infrastructure. While a sidewalk is present on one side, there are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or traffic control devices to manage interactions between people and vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked path for pedestrians to cross the wide commercial driveway entrance.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the asphalt entrance

hazards.name: Uncontrolled vehicle access
hazards.description: Vehicles enter and exit the commercial area without stop signs or signals, creating unpredictable conflict points for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the main road and the commercial driveway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Add signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians at the commercial entrance.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane commercial corridor with a signalized intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure like marked crosswalks or signals. While sidewalks are present, the environment is heavily car-oriented with long crossing distances and no physical protection for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, making pedestrian movements unpredictable for drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection area

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate safe crossing intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow for two-stage crossing and reduce exposure to traffic.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide multi-lane arterial road with a grassy median and overhead traffic signals but a complete absence of pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or pedestrian signals, creating a highly hostile environment for anyone attempting to navigate the area on foot.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: The total lack of sidewalks and marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and intersection area

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cover a significant distance without a marked path or dedicated signal phase.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and open geometry suggest high vehicle speeds, which increases the risk of severe injury in the event of a collision.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes

interventions.title: Sidewalk Network Completion
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks along both sides of the roadway to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks and pedestrian countdown signals to provide a protected and visible crossing opportunity.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps at the intersection to ensure accessibility for all users.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed arterial road that is extremely hostile to pedestrians due to a total lack of dedicated infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or pedestrian signals, forcing any non-motorized users into direct conflict with multi-lane vehicle traffic.
